name: pixelforge
description: Pixel art and sprite animation for agents: JSON recipes to PNG, APNG, GIF and sprite sheets.
long_description: Create, inspect and revise pixel art from editable JSON recipes. Export sprites, animations, atlases and scenes with eight local MCP tools. The server makes no network requests. Choose a workspace for local recipe references and generated artwork.

tools.name: pixel_help
tools.description: Read the authoring guide, schemas and a complete editable example.

tools.name: pixel_validate
tools.description: Validate a recipe, report dimensions and timing, and save an immutable revision.

tools.name: pixel_inspect
tools.description: Inspect frames as contact sheets and palette-key grids, with optional diagnostics.

tools.name: pixel_patch
tools.description: Apply targeted recipe edits, canvas corrections or overlays and compare the result.

tools.name: pixel_render
tools.description: Export sprites, atlases, animations and a Canvas player into a new unique folder.

tools.name: pixel_compile
tools.description: Compile poses, autotile templates or seeded particle effects into editable recipes.

tools.name: pixel_scene
tools.description: Render and inspect scene placements and tilemaps, with optional scene or frame exports.

tools.name: pixel_import
tools.description: Import an 8-bit RGB/RGBA PNG as an editable recipe without changing its pixels.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.description: Folder PixelForge may read recipe and PNG references from. Renders and revisions go in its PixelForge subfolder, created on first use. Choose a project folder to keep its files together.
